description: Generate a weekly workout program by goal, training days, equipment and level — with exercises, sets, reps and rest times.

faqs.a: Pick Build strength, Build muscle, Lose fat or Endurance, then your days per week, available equipment and experience level.
Strength uses heavy 5×5 compounds, muscle uses 3–4×8–12, fat loss adds circuits and cardio finishers, endurance uses higher reps and shorter rest.
faqs.q: Do sets and reps change with the goal?

faqs.a: Full gym, dumbbells-only, or bodyweight — the exercise pool adapts to what you have.
Yes, everything is generated locally in your browser.

howto: Choose your goal, training days per week, equipment and level.
Follow the day-by-day plan with sets, reps and rest.
title: Workout Plan Generator
